newsitem.title: ZIMBABWE: Zimbabwe industrials jump in active trade.
newsitem.headline: Zimbabwe industrials jump in active trade.

text.p: Zimbabwe industrial shares jumped in active trade on Friday to finish stronger but just off the week's closing high of 10,724.34 points.
The industrial index added 51.44 points to 10,699.79 on Friday after closing last week at 10,674.03.

Dealers said industrials were still buoyed by strong underlying fundamentals and were likely to see further good demand next week. They said that the new issues were being welcomed, warmly adding to liquidity and fuelling the bullishness.
"The market is very positive at the moment and looks set to continue upward for a little while longer," one dealer said.
Caps, Meikles and Delta traded in reasonable turnover at previous levels.
Newly-listed TZI put on 50 cents to 5,250, Zimpapers grew 50 cents to 3,150 cents and Barclays jumped 50 cents to 3,700 cents.
Truworths shed 50 cents to 900 cents and H & S lost 130 cents to 500 cents.
Mining shares inched up in more active trading with Ashanti and Rio Tinto trading at previous levels. Wankie added five cents to 505 cents and Bindura rose 15 cents to 715 cents.
But Falgold cut five cents to 65 cents.
The mining index gained 6.42 points to 901.42.
